exposure: Robson's Ten Group Classification System categories
cohort: The study included 54,041 births registered in the Calabria Region of Italy between 2017 and 2020.
finding: The study revealed a fluctuating caesarean section rate (36.2%-38.1%) in the Calabria Region, with Robson Group 5 (previous CS) consistently increasing and Robson Group 1 (nulliparous, cephalic, spontaneous labor) decreasing.
mod_finding: The study observed high and fluctuating caesarean section rates (36.2%-38.1%), with a concerning increase in CS for women with a previous caesarean section (Robson Group 5) and persistently high rates for nulliparous and multiparous women undergoing pre-labour CS.
